answer: One fake identity is one nebula. The nadir is the registry: it halves a lineage’s whole influence quota whenever a fork is added; because influence doubles per attested epoch, \(N\) sibling clones each need \(T+N-1\) epochs to retain one \(T\)-epoch honest vote. Each epoch burns a separate scarce forge, so the bill is \(N(T+N-1)\) forge; parallel forks share none. A colluding registrar quorum defeats it.
